scenarios.parent_care: Goal: Build a fund for the long-term care of ageing parents, while keeping the stated reserve for medical expenses that may arise within months.
scenarios.inflation_protection: Goal: Protect the purchasing power of savings over several years while keeping the stated reserve for routine expenses.
